evidence.title: PolyChirp: Multi-Species Birdsong Classification Using TinyML on Low-Power Acoustic Sensors

summary: Researchers have introduced PolyChirp, a TinyML model that can identify numerous bird species from audio recorded by ultra‑low‑power acoustic sensors. The system runs directly on the sensor hardware, providing real‑time, energy‑efficient monitoring of avian populations in the field.
title: TinyML Enables Multi‑Species Birdsong Classification on Low‑Power Sensors
